issues.description: The Person model's firstName field has different visibility between template and solution: the template declares firstName as private while the solution declares it as public. The problem statement and other code (controllers/services) expect access via getters/setters, so this visibility difference is an unintended inconsistency that may confuse students about the intended encapsulation and how to access the field.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of firstName consistent across template and solution. Prefer using private fields with public getters/setters (i.e., change the solution's public firstName to private and rely on getFirstName()/setFirstName()), which aligns with encapsulation and the rest of the code.
